اقتضيا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَضَيَا (iqtaḍayā) /iq.ta.dˤa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
# اُقْتُضِيَا (uqtuḍiyā) /uq.tu.dˤi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
# اِقْتَضِيَا (iqtaḍiyā) /iq.ta.dˤi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
